_doc: The 10 canonical sagas grouping the 33 arcs of One Piece. Each saga has a chapter range, the arcs it contains, and a brief description.

sagas.name: East Blue
sagas.summary: Luffy assembles his crew (Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji) and they conquer the East Blue's most notorious pirates. Ends with the Strawhats setting sail for the Grand Line.

sagas.name: Alabasta
sagas.summary: Crew enters the Grand Line, gains Chopper and Vivi as a temporary member, defeats Sir Crocodile and Baroque Works, saves Alabasta from civil war.

sagas.name: Sky Island
sagas.summary: Strawhats sail to the sky on the Knock-Up Stream, discover Skypiea, defeat Enel and ring the Golden Bell of Shandora.

sagas.name: Water 7
sagas.summary: Foxy Pirates · CP9 attacks Water 7 · the Strawhats burn the World Government flag at Enies Lobby for Robin · Going Merry's farewell · Robin officially joins · Franky joins · the Thousand Sunny is born.

sagas.name: Thriller Bark
sagas.summary: Spooky Warlord arc — Gecko Moria, the Mysterious Four, the Ghost Ship. Brook joins the crew.

sagas.name: Summit War
sagas.summary: Kuma scatters the Strawhats. Luffy crashes Impel Down, then Marineford to save Ace. Ace dies. Whitebeard dies declaring 'One Piece is real.' The 2-year timeskip begins. The crew trains.

sagas.name: Fish-Man Island
sagas.summary: Reunion after the timeskip. Crew descends to the bottom of the sea, defeats Hody Jones, meets Shirahoshi (a Poseidon weapon), enters the New World.

sagas.name: Dressrosa
sagas.summary: Punk Hazard alliance with Law and Smoker against Caesar Clown and Vergo. Dressrosa: defeat Doflamingo, free the country, the Strawhat Grand Fleet is formed.

sagas.name: Yonko
sagas.summary: Mink alliance · Strawhats split — Sanji rescue from Big Mom · Reverie reveals Imu · Wano: Kaidou and Big Mom defeated · Luffy awakens Gear 5 · Buggy joins the Yonko · the Worst Generation reshape the world.

sagas.name: Final Saga
sagas.summary: Cross Guild forms · Vegapunk's broadcast reveals Void Century truths · Five Elders attack Egghead · Strawhats race for Laugh Tale and the truth of the world. Currently ongoing.
